q: 1. Which type of membership is categorized in NEC Act 2055?
options: Senior divisional engineer, superintending engineer and foreign engineer
Gazzetted 1st class, Gazzetted 2nd class, Gazzetted 3rd class
explain: NEC Act 2055 classifies registered engineers as general, professional and foreign engineers. The other options are government service designations.

q: 2. The number of members in NEC are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council has 21 members.

q: 3. For the registration of general engineer the amount of fee required is
explain: The registration fee prescribed for a General Engineer under NEC rules is NRs 1,500 (later revised upward to NRs 3,000).

q: 4. The minimum qualification required for a professional engineer is
explain: Registration as a Professional Engineer requires a Master's degree in engineering along with the required experience.

q: 5. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ लालमोहर र प्रकाशन मिति कुन हो ?
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 received royal assent and formal publication on 2055/11/27 BS.

q: 6. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिष‌द्मा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन ?
explain: According to the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055, the executive council is composed of 18 total members including the Chairman and Vice-Chairman.

q: 7. NEC मा NEA मध्ये निर्वाचन गरी पठाएको सदस्यहरुको संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) elects and sends 5 representative members to the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC).

q: 8. NEC मा मनोनित वा निवार्चित सदस्यको पदावधि कति दिनको हुन्छ ?
explain: As per the provisions of the NEC Act, the tenure of nominated or elected members of the Council is 4 years.

q: 9. NEC अन्तर्गत कतिवटा नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ व्यवसायलाई संलग्न गरिएको छ?
explain: There are 25 recognized main streams/disciplines classified under the technical engineering practice framework in NEC rules.

q: 10. NEC was established in ........ BS.
explain: NEC was established under the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055 BS.

q: 11. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद्‌को अध्यक्ष पदको लागी न्युन्तम योग्यता कति निर्धारण गरिएको छ?
explain: The minimum educational requirement for appointment as Chairman of the Nepal Engineering Council is a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (along with experience qualifications).

q: 12. NEC ले इन्जिनियरहरुलाई कति भागमा बिभाजन गरेका छन् ?
explain: NEC categorizes registered engineers into 3 primary classifications: General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreign Engineer.

q: 13. The Engineering Council members consist of the following members
explain: The governing board/council of the Nepal Engineering Council is comprised of 18 executive members.

q: 14. For the registration of general engineer the amount of fee required is
explain: As specified under the NEC Regulations schedule of fees, the standard application fee for a General Engineer registration is NRs 3000.

q: 15. For the registration of foreginer engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: Foreign engineers registering to practice in Nepal under Category C/Foreign Engineer are charged NRs 15,000.

q: 16. The minimum qulification required for a general engineer is
explain: To register as a General Engineer with NEC, the baseline academic qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech).

q: 17. The minimum qulification & experience required for the registration of foreigner engineers is
options: bacheclor in engg. and 5 years experience
master in engg. and 5 yrs experience
explain: A foreign engineer must possess a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in engineering along with 10 years of professional work experience to register in NEC.

q: 18. In which year (B.S) was the Nepal Engineering Act promulgated?
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act was promulgated in 2055 B.S., establishing NEC as an autonomous regulatory body.

q: 19. The registered engineers in Nepal Engineering council should have to renew registration in:
explain: NEC registration renewal does not follow a fixed 1/2/4-year cycle under the given options; the actual renewal requirement differs, so 'none of the above' is correct as per the answer key.

q: 20. NEC act and its regulation..........
explain: The NEC Act was promulgated in 2055 BS and the accompanying NEC Regulations were issued in 2057 BS.

q: 21. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in engineering Council rule, 2057 for registration?
explain: The NEC Rule 2057 recognizes categories such as General, Professional, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer, but does not include 'Chartered Engineer' as a registration category.

q: 22. NEC does not approach for
explain: NEC does not provide direct upgrading routes from Overseer (Diploma) level to Engineer without obtaining an accredited Bachelor's degree in engineering.

q: 23. What is the provision in Engineer Council Act and Regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices Engineering work without registering into the Nepal Engineering Council?
options: Rs. 3, 000 fine or imprisonment of 3 months or both
Rs. 1, 000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both
explain: Under NEC Act provisions, practicing engineering without registration can attract a fine of Rs. 3,000 or imprisonment up to 3 months, or both.

q: 24. गैह नेपाली दर्तावाला इन्जिनियरहरुको नाम दर्ता गर्दाको लागी गरिनेछ ।
explain: The standard duration of validity for foreign engineering registration under NEC regulations is up to 3 years.

q: 25. परिषद्ले प्राप्त भएको रकम वाणिज्य बैंकमा जम्मा गर्दा खाता संचालन कसको नाममा हुन्छः
options: अध्यक्ष वा रजिष्ट्रार र लेखा अधिकृत
explain: The financial bank operations of NEC require joint signatures from either the Chairman or Registrar along with the Chief Accountant.

q: 26. NEC is an autonomous body as per NEC Act
explain: Nepal Engineering Council was established as an autonomous body under the NEC Act, 2055 B.S.

q: 27. Civil service act, Nepal was effective from
explain: The Civil Service Act of Nepal became effective from 2038 B.S.

q: 28. Tenure of registrar of NEC is ........
explain: The answer key gives 2 years here, which conflicts with its answer to Q4 (4 years). Verify against the NEC Act.

q: 29. NEC publishes the name of registered foreign engineer ........
explain: As per the answer key, the list of registered foreign engineers is published every year.

q: 30. What if the providing in engineer council act and regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices engineering work without registering into the Nepal engineering council?
options: Rs. 3,000 fine or imprisonment of 3 month or both
Rs 1,000 fine or imprisonment of 1 month or both
explain: Under NEC Act provisions, unauthorized practice of engineering without registration is punishable by a fine of Rs. 3,000 or imprisonment up to 3 months, or both.

q: 31. Extreme measure of punitive action against an engineering practice without being registered in the Nepal engineering council include:
explain: Imprisonment represents the most extreme punitive measure among the options for practicing engineering without NEC registration.

q: 32. Professional code of conduct issued by Nepal Engineering Council has
explain: The professional code of conduct framed by NEC contains 8 core articles governing professional practice.

q: 33. Five members are elected from Nepal Engineers Association members to represent in Nepal Engineering Council every:
explain: As per election tenure alignment, NEA representatives are elected every 2 years during regular organizational elections.

q: 34. In general, Nepal Engineering Council meeting per year should be held:
explain: Statutory requirements mandate that NEC must hold its council meetings at least 4 times per year.

q: 35. The member secretary of NEC is ........
explain: The registrar serves as the member secretary of the council.

q: 36. The numbers of chapters in NEC act 2055 are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 7 chapters.

q: 37. The function of Nepal Engineering Council is to:
options: register and issue license to engineers
Enforce engineering profession code of conduct
regulate the required standard of educational facilities of engineering colleges
explain: NEC's functions comprehensively include registering and licensing engineers, enforcing the code of conduct, and regulating educational standards for engineering colleges.

q: 38. Which is the professional body of architectural and engineering firms is Nepal?
options: Sociality of Consulting Engineering and Architectural firms
explain: SCAEF (Society of Consulting Architectural and Engineering Firms) represents private consulting firms in Nepal.

q: 39. Any Non-Nepali Engineer desiring to work in Nepal may apply for registration under:
explain: Foreign national engineers practicing in Nepal are registered under Category C as defined by the council rules.

q: 40. The general experience required for nomination of chairperson of NEC is :
explain: The Chairperson of NEC must have at least 15 years of professional engineering experience following graduation.
